questions.instructions: Is the item on this receipt line itself household goods? Yes: The item is household goods: cleaning and laundry products, paper towels, tissues, toilet paper, rubbish bags, kitchenware, drinkware and barware, bedding, furniture, small appliances, home décor. No: The item is not household goods. Decide what the item IS, not what words its name contains. The merchant and the declared expense type are context only and never override the item itself.
